caveats: Headless Chromium on this host; narrow viewport is an emulation, not a physical phone.
rAF cadence and input-dispatch-to-next-rAF are proxies; they do not measure compositor presentation or pixel-visible latency.
The continuous rAF series includes time between host-dispatched samples and JSON writes; inspect raw per-event samples for the interaction response.
UV samples time the named setParameter/update path and are reported separately from pointer gestures.
Per-renderer medians describe these prototypes and are not interchangeable operation-cost comparisons.
